@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+accessWidener	v1	official
+
+# Read private fields of Minecraft's registry/holder codecs so the schema resolver can
+# introspect them. These are net.minecraft.* classes, so string reflection would break on
+# Fabric's intermediary runtime - widening keeps it remap-safe on both loaders.
+accessible	field	net/minecraft/core/registries/codec/RegistryFileCodec	registryKey	Lnet/minecraft/resources/ResourceKey;
+accessible	field	net/minecraft/core/registries/codec/RegistryFileCodec	elementCodec	Lcom/mojang/serialization/Codec;
+accessible	field	net/minecraft/core/registries/codec/RegistryFileCodec	allowInline	Z
+accessible	field	net/minecraft/core/registries/codec/RegistryFixedCodec	registryKey	Lnet/minecraft/resources/ResourceKey;
\ No newline at end of file
